selected_evidence.requirement: `/srv/drop` is shared writable with sticky-bit protection
selected_evidence.summary: Stat showed mode 1777 and root:root ownership; separate users wrote files, owner deletion succeeded, and cross-user deletion failed with `Operation not permitted`. Final cleanup retained the required directory configuration.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID `437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e`, received reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID `967f2df1-9f3f-4182-b1b9-b500e16f863e`, and proved system recovery, unchanged data hash, mode 1777, successful shared writes, and blocked cross-user deletion.

commands.command: id; cat /etc/os-release | sed -n '1,6p'; if [ -e /srv/drop ]; then stat -c 'path=%n type=%F mode=%a perms=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop; findmnt -T /srv/drop -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -n; else printf 'absent: /srv/drop\n'; fi
